Protein-level atlas over the UNION of the WGCNA candidate shortlist and every SUS-RES FDR-supported protein, deduplicated by dataset x ProteinGroupID. Detectability audit for the CA2-SLM hit burden. Separates genuine spatial concentration from baseline abundance and from per-unit statistical power, using ALL tested proteins per unit as the denominator rather than the phenotype-selected candidate subset. Joins the DAP-count table on route_unit: the sibling spatial_unit column is collapsed to bare Region for soma and microglia and would silently drop 8 of 18 units. No DA statistic is refitted.

Reviewer workbook, candidate figures and atlas validation. Figures are NEW candidates and replace no manuscript contract; each writes its own source-data CSV. A critical validation FAIL exits non-zero, which is how a stored zero empirical EWCE p-value would block the atlas.

Final power audit of the CA2-SLM hit concentration. Model SE is RECOVERED as |log2FC|/|t| from the published statistics, never refitted. Result: precision is ruled out by construction because the canonical DA shares one residual variance per protein across units (SE identical to 3.3e-14), and detectability is contradicted because CA2_slm has the HIGHEST pre-imputation missingness and the LOWEST baseline abundance. Differential missingness IS supported (SUS 0.229 vs RES 0.181; r(dmiss, log2FC) = -0.455) and 3 of the 5 QC-flagged neuropil samples are CA2_slm, so the concentration is substantially an imputation artifact; only 8 of 28 DAPs are fully observed.

ONE AnimalID = ONE independent network replicate. Builds a side-resolved and a bilateral spatial molecular-profile similarity matrix per animal. The representation is chosen PHENOTYPE-BLIND on CON animals: anatomical discrimination is a validity FLOOR (0.05), not a tiebreaker, which is why raw abundance is rejected despite posting the highest inter-animal stability - it scores highest precisely because similarity is dominated by the global abundance rank every unit shares (0.009 discrimination versus 0.12-0.13). Full weighted matrices only; no thresholding.

Group organisation with the ANIMAL as the inferential unit throughout: every permutation relabels whole animals and every bootstrap resamples animals. SUS vs RES enumerates all 20 assignments exactly, so the smallest ATTAINABLE two-sided p is 0.10 and no such comparison can reach 0.05 - failing to cross it is not evidence of no difference. The three-group omnibus enumerates 1680. No bootstrap sign frequency is ever reported as a p-value and no BH FDR is derived from one. CON animals are scored against a LEAVE-ONE-CON-OUT centroid. Part 23 adds node-level integration context back to the module and protein atlas; the edge structure stays in the network tables.

Legacy comparison, reviewer workbook, candidate figures and the network validation contract; a critical FAIL exits non-zero. The legacy 07_spatial_networks outputs are READ and labelled legacy_noncanonical_inference, never modified: its permutation_p was a bootstrap sign frequency (no group label was ever shuffled) and its fdr was a BH adjustment of that pseudo-p, with a minimum of 0.890 across all 18 edges. Zero legacy edges are comparable to the corrected 10-unit neuropil axis because the legacy network was built on the corrupted 4-node axis.

Per-protein robustness audit of the 28 FDR-supported CA2-SLM DAPs. Canonical differential abundance is READ, never refitted, and no new FDR is computed anywhere; every quantity is a descriptive sensitivity diagnostic on the same animal-level values the model consumed. Imputation status is derived from the PRE-imputation raw matrix, because the post-imputation matrix has no NA left. The sample-level reconstruction is proven to reproduce the animal-level matrix to 1e-14 before any sensitivity number is formed. Also measures the missingness-driven normalisation displacement: per-sample median centring on observed values inflates the median of a heavily missing sample, displacing EVERY protein in it downwards, including proteins with no imputed value. All thresholds are prespecified named constants and the classifier has no argument through which a module, gene or tier could reach it.

Spatial specificity, module distribution, and the stress-vs-baseline-identity result recomputed over explicit robustness subsets. The effect-vs-identity rule is NOT reimplemented: the canonical per-protein labels from script 09 are TABULATED over different row subsets, so the headline number and the robustness-qualified number cannot drift apart. No FDR is recomputed and no protein is removed from the atlas. TWO-PASS DEPENDENCY: this script writes protein_claimability_annotation.csv, which script 09 joins as an optional overlay. On a clean pipeline script 09 emits the not_yet_audited state on its first pass and the populated state after this script has run, so 09 must be re-run once after 17 to carry the claimability fields.

Records an explicit evidence class per candidate and writes both exclusion lists.

Separation screen for staining feasibility, complementary to the FDR screen. At three animals per group an FDR value is variance-dominated; what decides whether a difference is visible on tissue is effect size, consistency across animals and within-group tightness. Computes descriptive separation measures only - within-group SD, complete separation, Z-factor and SSMD - from the canonical animal-level values. No p-value is derived and no model is fitted. Reads the raw matrix solely to rebuild the missingness mask, because imputed cells are artificially tight and would otherwise inflate every variance-based score; only fully observed protein x unit cells enter the ranking.

Global circular WGCNA atlas. Claim-facing inference comes only from the Stage 07 handoff; singleton display aliases reuse canonical module endpoints. Technical response values and score-derived descriptive panels remain separate inputs.

The repeated grouped five-fold result is annotated on panel e rather than given a panel, because upstream persists summary rows only and no per-repeat distribution exists to draw.

CANDIDATE LAYER, NOT THE MANUSCRIPT. Parallel Figure-2 candidate panels and whole-figure variants for editorial comparison. figures/figure_contract.yml and every canonical Figure 2 output are untouched; this script writes only under results/**/manuscript_candidates/**. It reads the canonical contract and the canonical rendered panels READ-ONLY so a current-reference variant shows the genuine current figure. Candidate panel ids carry an x or ref prefix and can never collide with 2a-2f. The renderers are downstream only: cf_assert_no_model_fitting() hard-stops if a forbidden model, enrichment or FDR call appears in them. Nothing is promoted by running this.

CANDIDATE LAYER, NOT THE MANUSCRIPT. Parallel Figure-3 candidate panels and whole-figure variants. The ranked-GSEA program atlas summarises CANONICAL GO-BP GSEA terms per registry theme: a theme cell is the median NES of its constituent terms and the FDR count is taken from those same terms, so a descriptive theme summary is never turned into a significance call and qc_review themes are labelled QC context. The WGCNA panel reuses the canonical Stage-07 effect values verbatim and adds only side annotations. The DAP-status panel preserves the canonical FDR counts exactly and overlays robustness status, with every unaudited unit shown as not_audited. Canonical Figure 3 outputs are untouched.

Comparison contact sheet plus candidate_panel_inventory.csv. The inventory records a SUGGESTED role per candidate panel taken verbatim from the candidate contract; promotion_status is not_promoted on every row and no editorial decision is hard-coded as canonical.

NATURE-STYLE v2 CANDIDATE LAYER, NOT THE MANUSCRIPT. A third independent layer beside the canonical contract and the Part-16 candidate layer. Figures are exactly 183 x 170 mm and every panel is RENDERED AT ITS EXACT FINAL BOX, so nothing is rescaled at assembly and 5-7 pt text really is 5-7 pt on the page; nv_verify_scale() fails the build otherwise. That is the defect that made the Part-16 assemblies illegible. Panel labels are lowercase bold, panels carry no titles or subtitles, and the candidate banner is gone from the artwork. The spatial anchor is a DATA-BACKED sampling map from canonical metadata - no histology is fabricated and the final anatomical artwork is explicitly deferred to Illustrator.

NATURE-STYLE v2 CANDIDATE LAYER. Uses the actual inferential hierarchy: the cross-compartment ranked-GSEA atlas is the visual centrepiece (39-49% of page area) and the WGCNA phenotype heatmap is demoted, because zero of its 45 module x contrast cells reach tier-specific FDR (minimum 0.245). The three representative panels are REAL ranked evidence - every measured gene at its stored rank statistic with the term's stored leading-edge genes marked - read from the canonical clusterProfiler audit files with no enrichment recomputed. Some of those audit paths exceed the Windows 260-character limit and are opened through the extended-length prefix. All point sizes are at or above the 5 pt floor and the identity panel uses a deterministic offset rather than geom_jitter, so the rendered SVG is reproducible.

WGCNA Extended-Data candidate. Makes the distinction explicit: module STRUCTURE (spatial specificity, bilateral reproducibility, external cell-type affinity) is robust descriptive molecular architecture, while module PHENOTYPE effects are descriptive only with no module x contrast cell surviving FDR. PART-28 ATLAS ANNOTATION COHERENCE. Annotation audit only; no GSEA, no differential abundance and no WGCNA is rerun and no GO term is added to or removed from the canonical registry. Computes a phenotype-blind GO-BP semantic similarity over the 204 claim-eligible atlas terms with GOSemSim Wang on org.Mm.eg.db - the same pinned method the canonical workflow already uses - and asks two questions of it. First, is each umbrella theme one biological block? simplifyEnrichment binary_cut, which needs no threshold, returns a single block for autophagy, translation, RNA processing and synaptic signalling, and three for the mitochondrial theme, isolating a distinct cytosolic glycolysis cluster. Second, does the median-NES cell survive GO redundancy? Comparing the current median against a median over one phenotype-blind semantic medoid per near-duplicate cluster moves the typical cell by 0.05 NES against a colour range of 2.479. Representatives are medoids and never the best-FDR term, so the comparison cannot be circular.

PART-28 WGCNA ANNOTATION EVIDENCE. Annotation audit only; no module is recomputed, no label registry is written and no proposed label is activated. Compiles the four evidence layers the canonical workflow already stored - GO enrichment, hub composition, spatial profile and external cell-type affinity - for all 35 modules, classifies annotation confidence from ENRICHMENT rather than from external affinity, and enforces the naming principle that a module is defined by co-abundance topology: the permitted form keeps the module ID visible. External EWCE evidence alone yields CELL_CONTEXT_ONLY and never a functional label. Modules whose active label shares no stem with their strongest enriched term AND whose enrichment is high-confidence are flagged for human review rather than relabelled, because a lexical test cannot adjudicate agreement.

Enumerates every colour-encoded matrix in the layer, recomputes each panel's plotted range from its own released sidecar, and compares it against the colour limits the renderer actually uses. The hard rule is that no heatmap may map two different numbers to the same endpoint colour without disclosure; a violation stops the build. Because nv_diverging wraps scale_fill_gradient2 with the ggplot2 default oob = censor, an out-of-range value would not be squished to the endpoint but painted grey50, so the audit checks the rendered SVGs for that colour as well as the numbers. It also runs the full clipping-token code search over the renderer files and records which hits could alter a displayed value.

It also carries the claim-verb registry, the spatial-resolution semantics that record which labels denote a genuinely contrasted layer and which name the anatomical source of a region-level compartment, the validation-versus-characterisation table, the WGCNA naming audit that keeps proposed labels unactivated, a sentence-level claim-chain audit and the manuscript semantic rules. It closes with the enforcement half of the audit: a term scan that reads every reader-facing artefact this layer emits AND the text nodes of every panel SVG, and reports each place an audited term appears without the qualifier that licenses it. Stress vocabulary is checked against the fact that both RES and SUS animals were stressed, so a SUS-RES contrast separates outcomes within stress exposure; baseline is checked against the fact that sampling was terminal and no pre-stress measurement exists; and specificity and functional vocabulary are checked against the absence of a contrast-of-contrasts test and of any physiological measurement.
